title: hotcrm: Generate Quote's discount screen field declares no `max: 60`, so "Discount cannot exceed 60%" ends the run instead of being refused at the field
body:
## Source

Out-of-scope finding from the #26882 card thread (PR #26956, report comment 6455809673), checked by the ui seat. Filed for the `repo:hotcrm` seat.

## Problem

In HotCRM, Opportunity → *Generate Quote* → Discount 75 → Submit shows "Discount cannot exceed 60%", and the dialog then offers only Close (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D1, `quo-12-generate-discount-75.png`). The console withdraws Submit only when the run is already over: a `refused` end, or a node failing after the resume consumed the suspension. `resumeInternal` in `service-automation`'s `run-resume.ts` calls `forgetSuspendedRun` before it traverses, and the only way to re-arm a run is the operator verb `restore-suspension`. So once the flow refuses downstream, no client can resubmit that run.

## Target

Declare the bound where the engine checks it before consuming the suspension: `max: 60` on the Generate Quote screen's discount field. The engine then refuses 75 as `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`, which is retryable, so the dialog keeps the values and Submit (pinned by PR #26956's last test), and the console refuses it before any request. Keep or drop the downstream refusal as the flow's own last guard. Measure first whether the 60% rule is a `refused` end or a decision node, and sweep HotCRM's other screen flows for the same shape.

## Acceptance

In HotCRM, Discount 75 on Generate Quote is refused on the screen with Submit kept, and Discount 60 proceeds.

Related: #26882, PR #26956, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320.
